prelude:
theorem fb_strLen (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (o l : BitVec 64) :
    denotePure or h .strLen [.str r o l] = .ok (.int 64 l) := rfl

theorem fb_strIndex0 (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (l : BitVec 64) (x : BitVec 8) (xs : List (BitVec 8))
    (hh : h[r]? = some (.arr ((x :: xs).map (.int 8)))) (hl0 : l ≠ 0#64) :
    denotePure or h .strIndex [.str r 0#64 l, .int 64 0#64] = .ok (.int 8 x) := by
  have hln : 0 < l.toNat := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l.toNat with e | e
    · exact absurd (BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq (by simpa using e)) hl0
    · exact e
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, l.toNat = n + 1 := ⟨l.toNat - 1, by omega⟩
  have hb : ∃ bs, strBytes h (.str r 0#64 l) = some (x.toNat :: bs) := by
    unfold strBytes
    split
    · rename_i hz
      exact absurd (Val.str.inj hz).2.2 hl0
    · rename_i a b c _ heq
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := Val.str.inj heq
      subst h1 h2 h3
      simp [hh, hn]
    · rename_i hz; exact absurd rfl (hz r 0#64 l)
  obtain ⟨bs, hb⟩ := hb
  unfold denotePure
  simp only [asIndex, hb]
  simp
  simp [BitVec.ult]; omega

theorem fb_bmod (x : BitVec 8) : 0 ≤ (↑x.toNat : Int).bmod 18446744073709551616 ∧ (↑x.toNat : Int).bmod 18446744073709551616 < 256 := by
  have := x.isLt
  have h : (↑x.toNat : Int).bmod 18446744073709551616 = x.toNat := by
    apply Int.bmod_eq_of_le <;> omega
  rw [h]; omega

post: ∃ n, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ s_.length
prelude:
@[simp] theorem cb_strLen (or : Oracle) (heap : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (o l : BitVec 64) :
    denotePure or heap .strLen [.str r o l] = .ok (.int 64 l) := rfl

theorem cb_strIndex (or : Oracle) (heap : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (l i : BitVec 64)
    (hl : l.toInt = xs.length) (hh : heap[r]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 8))))
    (hix : i.toNat < xs.length) (hi : i.ult l = true) :
    denotePure or heap .strIndex [.str r 0#64 l, .int 64 i] = .ok (.int 8 xs[i.toNat]) := by
  rw [denotePure.eq_def]
  have hln : l.toNat = xs.length := by
    have := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (i := l) (by omega); omega
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0#64 := by
    intro h; subst h; simp at hln; omega
  have hsb : strBytes heap (.str r 0#64 l) = some (xs.map (fun x => x.toNat)) := by
    simp [strBytes, hh, hln, Function.comp_def]
    exact List.take_of_length_le (by simp)
  simp only [asIndex, hsb]
  simp [hix, hi]

def cbInv (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (c : BitVec 8) (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 15 ∧ env[0]? = some (.str ref 0 len) ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 8 c) ∧
  s.assumed = #[] ∧ s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 8))) ∧
  ∃ n i : BitVec 64, env[2]? = some (.int 64 n) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧
    0 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt ≤ len.toInt ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ i.toInt

abbrev cbPost (xs : List (BitVec 8)) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun ret s' => s'.assumed = #[] ∧ (∃ n, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ xs.length)

theorem cb_step (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (c : BitVec 8) (orc : Oracle) (hv : Havoc Val)
   (hlen : len.toInt = xs.length) (hr : ref ≠ 0) :
    ∀ n env s, cbInv ref len c xs env s →
      (∀ env' s', cbInv ref len c xs env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨0, 1⟩ (cbPost xs) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog orc hv (n + 1) ⟨0, 1⟩ (cbPost xs) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, h0, h1, ha, hh, nn, i, h2, h3, hi0, hil, hn0, hni⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h2
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  wp_simp [f0]
  simp [e0, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    simp [e2, hsz, cbPost, ha]
    omega
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    have hiu : i.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hi0 hc
    have hin : (i.toNat : Int) = i.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hi0
    have hix : i.toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hi1 : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have hn1 : (nn + 1#64).toInt = nn.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    simp [e0, e1, e3, hsz, cb_strIndex orc s.heap ref xs len i hlen hh hix hiu]
    by_cases hx : xs[i.toNat] = c
    · simp only [hx, decide_true]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e2, hsz]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e3, hsz]
      refine wpPtN_le ?_ (ih _ _ ?_)
      · omega
      · refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz]; exact e0, by simp [hsz]; exact e1, ha, hh, nn + 1#64, i + 1#64, by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
    · simp only [hx, decide_false]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e3, hsz, e2]
      refine wpPtN_le ?_ (ih _ _ ?_)
      · omega
      · refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz]; exact e0, by simp [hsz]; exact e1, ha, hh, nn, i + 1#64, by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
